name: AvatarGroup
description: Wraps multiple Avatar components in a horizontal stack with overlap. When more avatars are provided than the max prop allows, an overflow badge displays the remaining count as '+N'.

notes: The root element has role=group to semantically associate the avatars.
Each Avatar retains its own accessible name via the name prop.
The overflow badge has aria-label='N more' to describe the hidden count.

max.description: Maximum number of avatars to display. Extras are collapsed into a '+N' overflow badge.

size.description: Size forwarded to each Avatar and the overflow badge. Controls visual dimensions.

children.description: Avatar components to display in the group.

className.description: Additional CSS class names to apply to the root element.

do: Pass Avatar components directly as children.
Provide a max prop to control how many avatars are visible.
Pass a matching size prop so all avatars in the group are consistent.
dont: Do not rely on CSS alone to control the number of visible avatars — use max.
